<script>
(() => {
  const menu = document.getElementById('menu');
  const scenario = document.getElementById('scenario');
  const game = document.getElementById('game');
  const exitScreen = document.getElementById('exitScreen');
  const saveKey = 'goddes-conquest-save-v1';
  const realms = [
    {name:'Crown',description:'The heartland answers to your banner.'},
    {name:'Ashen Veil',description:'A border keep stands between you and the northern road.'},
    {name:'Ravenhold',description:'A fortified pass guards the old kingdom.'},
    {name:'Mistwood',description:'A quiet forest hides a stubborn garrison.'},
    {name:'Frostfall',description:'The mountain stronghold watches from the far ridge.'}
  ];
  let state = null;
  let selected = null;
  let toastTimer;
  const buttons = [...document.querySelectorAll('.territory')];
  function freshGame(){return {day:1,essence:5,owned:[0],enemyPower:0};}
  function showScreen(which){[menu,scenario,game,exitScreen].forEach(screen=>screen.classList.toggle('active',screen===which));}
  function updateLoad(){document.getElementById('loadGame').disabled=!localStorage.getItem(saveKey);}
  function save(){if(state)localStorage.setItem(saveKey,JSON.stringify(state));updateLoad();}
  function start(next){state=next;selected=null;showScreen(game);render();}
  function render(){
    if(!state)return;
    document.getElementById('dayStat').textContent=state.day;
    document.getElementById('essenceStat').textContent=state.essence;
    document.getElementById('realmStat').textContent=`${state.owned.length} / ${realms.length}`;
    buttons.forEach((element,index)=>{
      const owned=state.owned.includes(index);
      element.classList.toggle('owned',owned);
      element.classList.toggle('enemy',!owned&&index<3);
      element.classList.toggle('locked',!owned&&index>=3);
      element.classList.toggle('selected',selected===index);
    });
    const details=selected===null?realms[state.owned[0]]:realms[selected];
    document.getElementById('realmName').textContent=details.name;
    document.getElementById('realmDescription').textContent=selected===null?'Select a neighboring realm to march.':state.owned.includes(selected)?'This realm flies beneath your banner.':`Conquer this realm and bring it beneath your banner.`;
    const canMarch=selected!==null&&!state.owned.includes(selected)&&state.owned.some(id=>Math.abs(id-selected)===1)&&state.essence>=2;
    document.getElementById('march').disabled=!canMarch;
  }
  function notify(message){const toast=document.getElementById('toast');toast.textContent=message;toast.hidden=false;clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>toast.hidden=true,1700);}
  const beginningScenario=document.getElementById('beginningScenario');
  const startScenario=document.getElementById('startScenario');
  document.getElementById('newGame').addEventListener('click',()=>{
    beginningScenario.classList.remove('selected');
    beginningScenario.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');
    document.getElementById('characterPanel').hidden=true;
    startScenario.disabled=true;
    document.querySelector('.scenario-hint').textContent='Select a scenario to choose your character.';
    showScreen(scenario);
  });
  beginningScenario.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    beginningScenario.classList.add('selected');
    beginningScenario.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');
    document.getElementById('characterPanel').hidden=false;
    startScenario.disabled=false;
    document.querySelector('.scenario-hint').textContent='Character selected: Lux Osborn.';
  });
  startScenario.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!startScenario.disabled)start(freshGame());});
  document.getElementById('scenarioBack').addEventListener('click',()=>showScreen(menu));
  document.getElementById('loadGame').addEventListener('click',()=>{try{const data=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(saveKey));if(data&&Array.isArray(data.owned))start(data);}catch{localStorage.removeItem(saveKey);updateLoad();}});
  document.getElementById('options').addEventListener('click',()=>{document.getElementById('optionsModal').hidden=false;});
  document.getElementById('closeOptions').addEventListener('click',()=>{document.getElementById('optionsModal').hidden=true;});
  document.getElementById('optionsModal').addEventListener('click',event=>{if(event.target.id==='optionsModal')event.currentTarget.hidden=true;});
  document.getElementById('motion').addEventListener('change',event=>{document.querySelector('.scene svg').style.animation=event.target.checked?'drift 40s ease-in-out infinite alternate':'none';});
  buttons.forEach(element=>element.addEventListener('click',()=>{const id=Number(element.dataset.id);if(state.owned.includes(id))selected=null;else selected=id;render();}));
  document.getElementById('march').addEventListener('click',()=>{
    const march=document.getElementById('march');if(march.disabled)return;
    state.essence-=2;state.owned.push(selected);state.owned.sort((a,b)=>a-b);selected=null;render();save();
    if(state.owned.length===realms.length){notify('Conquest Complete');return;}
